1: The patient presents with right lower abdominal pain, a firm non-tender mobile mass in the right lower quadrant, and imaging findings consistent with a pelvic mass, which are all consistent with an ovarian neoplasm.
The presence of a large hypoechoic lesion in the right adnexa on transvaginal ultrasound and a well-marginated thin-walled solid-cystic lesion on contrast-enhanced CT further support this diagnosis.
